chapters.label: Live in Turin
chapters.text: Juventus lead Real Madrid in the 2003 Champions League semi-final. Zambrotta looks up from halfway: a long pass... Pavel Nedved sprints between the two centre-backs... and buries it past Casillas! Three nil!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Nedved finds the gap between the defenders. He doesn't slow down. He doesn't wait. He shoots!

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: he hits it hard, before the defenders can close him down. Goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Nedved could shoot with either foot. Your turn: practise with your weaker foot, so you can shoot as soon as you get space.
